title: 权衡感知的区域设计：企业客户到销售分配的多目标决策系统
summary: 本文提出一个用于B2B GTM规划的生产级决策系统，整合账户价值预测、基于合成控制反事实的连续性估值和多目标优化三层，在增长、平衡、容量与可行性间权衡分配销售覆盖。回测与生产表明，采用场景提升了分配合规性与机会均衡。
summary_en: This paper presents a production decision system for B2B GTM customer-to-seller allocation, integrating predictive account-value scoring, a synthetic-control counterfactual layer estimating relationship-breakage cost, and multi-objective optimization balancing growth, continuity, capacity, and feasibility. Backtesting and production use show improved assignment compliance and opportunity balance.
